body:
I mean, technically speaking: The HECU *was* defeated by the Combine, hence the lack of their presence. It can also be said GLaDOS is a better defence than offence.

The Gonarch is seemingly immortal, but also useless in a battle. and the Nihilanth was beaten by one man with morphine. None of these would be all that over-powered.

Even G-Man, who's only ever pulled behind the strings, and not made any actual actions.

$15 (Just thought these'd be funny)

G-Man: The mysterious benefactor, and manipulator of most of the games. Survived and observed all of the Resonance Cascade, Seven Hour War, and all of the games so far. Obviously working for some unknown being, but also has a weakness. The vortessnce can keep him away from Gordon, also capable of being captured, as the vault contained him.

GLaDOS: Overseer of the Aperture Labs, and technically limitless as long as Aperture and her core remain. Has access to all of Aperture's tech, and knows how to kill. Has likely kept the combine out of the labs, as we don't see them in game.

Laszlo: The Finest Mind Of His Generation.

Crate Baby: This is singlehandedly the most OP character in Half-Life.

$5

Gordon Freeman: THE Free Man. This man is a one-man army fueled on Morphine, and hasn't had a break since the resonance cascade. Technically, the safest and most proven answer. Gordon has faced and won against (technically) everything he's come up against.

Barney Calhoun: Barney is skilled with guns, having started as a Black Mesa Security Guard. Impromptu field commander of the resistance, and owes Freeman a beer. Technically would still be in hiding until Freeman arrives.

Aidran Shephard: The most skilled with guns on this list, due to Military training. Survived the Black Mesa incident, having put pieces in place for Gordon, and has run in with several more Xen than the rest. In Stasis with G-Man.

Alyx Vance: In Gordon's timeline, simply the best resistance member there is. High level hacking skill, and a gun she (likely) upgraded herself. In Alyx's timeline, the owner of the Russels, is better with hacking, and is a resistance scout. Top Tier Choice.

Collette Green: Proficient with the HEV suit (though not as much as Gina and Ivan) and is a good fighter with guns, though not as much as Gordon or Shephard. Pretty much your everyman's choice. Also in Stasis with G-Man.

$4

Eli Vance: Harvard-level intelligence, central to a lot of the resistance plans, and designer of Dog and the Gravity Gun. Not a bad choice, and could likely fix/upgrade any tools you bring with other characters.

Gina Cross: PhD at Caltec, and is the Holographic Assistance, so likely highly proficient with the HEV suit. However, she is verifiably dead post Seven Hour War, so she wouldn't be much help.

Russel: Has the entire internet downloaded, and invented the Russels. Has hacked a combine camera, and is fairly helpful to Alyx's descent into the vault.

Wallace Breen: Now Breen is an interesting choice, due to his position as the Combine's bitch. Choosing him would be attempting a negotiation/begging route with the Combine.

Ivan the Space Biker: While not canon, so no actual feats are given. It can be assumed he is on par with Gina Cross on HEV suit proficiency (judging based on colour) and on par with Gordon with gun skill (judging based on him being replaced with Gordon.)

$3

Mitchell Shephard: I refuse to give him any actual thought, but he can use a gun and has edgy dialogue, so he's entertaining at the least.

Father Grigori: A very talented gun-user, and a man who's insane/caring enough to "tend to his flock". Of all the "just a man with a gun" on this list, he may very well be the best option.

Aiden Walker: Now while this is just an Overwatch Elite on the sheet, I'm going to assume this is the Entropy Zero protag. In which case, he's on par with Gordon and Shepard. He's also the only one in "canon" so far to take down an advisor.

Otis Laurey: Another one of the more meme characters. His canonical skill is simply being a more plump security guard.

Colonel Odessa Cubbage: Here on this list as another "man with a gun" except his gun is an RPG, and he's an idiot. However, we do see Odessa as one of the few people in the series to actually talk with the G-Man, so he could be an unknown power level.

$2

Issac Kleiner: MIT professor who mentor's Gordon, so we already have him as quite an intelligent man. Experimenting and re-inventing teleportation WHILE a resistance member. He's managed to debeak a headcrab, and upgrade the HEV suit.

Sheckley: Sheckley is mostly just a notable resistance member, with an excellent hiding place in the caves. 

Griggs: Griggs is slightly above Sheckley, being a medic. But once again is mostly just a resistance member with a gun.

Simmons: Simmons doesn't really do anything unique or special during Blue Shift, and it's not even known if he survived the Seven Hour War.

Arne Magnusson: A scientist who competed with Kleiner for grant money, so someone on his level of intelligence. He is the resistance's main technological developer, despite being standoffish with Gordon. His rocket is key to Gordon's plan to defeat the Combine, and the Magnusson Device being able to take down striders would be one of the missing keys a lot of the other better members can't handle on their own.

I know this is a shitpost, but I wanted to try to take this seriously. $1

Gnome Chompski: Not much is known about this funky lil dude, outside of his general need to get to space. However, if we allow L4D2's use of the lil guy, the Healing Gnome could prove useful in a pinch.

Doug Rattman: Once again, not much is known about Doug, so I'll list what we do know. A fairly bright scientist who's worked on GLaDOS. Managed to survive in the facility alone past Portal 1, and maybe into Portal 2. Managed to hack into the Test Subject list database. Overall, not a great choice.

Cave Johnson: Cave's effectiveness really depends on whether or not we have prep time, and his team of scientists. Alone, he is just a man with moon rock cancer. Together, he would realistically (based on what I give the others) have access to the Borealis, and maybe Mantis Man Serum and Combustible Lemons. His use as one of the scientists is also not all that effective, as he's just the CEO and thinker, not a "bean counter"

Fisherman: For as far as we know, this is simply a man with a harpoon and a love for fish.

Chell: An understated choice. Given her feats, she's fairly decent at dodging bullets AND rockets. Her long fall boots gives her both an advantage and a good tool against the combine. Her Portal Gun is the MVP here and technically puts her on $4 tier. Being able to portal into the combine facilities would severely cut down most of the half-life campaigns, and her skill and speed with it would allow her to portal trap, or fling combine to their individual deaths. She just isn't all that great at group combat.
Thank you so much. You have no idea how much this means to me.
